plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Sociology (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] A grade of C or better is required.
[grid1 fn2] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn3] Any 100-499 level course may be taken. No more than 6 semester credit hours for SOCI 484 may be applied to the Bachelor of Arts degree in Sociology.
[grid1 fn4] SOCI courses do not count toward fulfilling this requirement.
